verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is a hosted search/database service, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The SDKs, llms.txt and the public OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
